info.name: ENHYPEN "Moonstruck" Concert Theme (testing)
info.description:
ENHYPEN "Moonstruck" Concert Theme for Roblox

Bring the stunning pink moon and silhouette aesthetic from ENHYPEN's iconic "Moonstruck" performance to your Roblox dashboard! 

Features:
• High-quality ENHYPEN background wallpaper.
• Transparent, dark glass panels so the background glows through beautifully.
• Custom frosted-glass top navigation bar.rt
info.additionalInfo: A clean, high-quality dark theme for Roblox featuring a stunning ENHYPEN "Moonstruck" silhouette wallpaper. It features customized glassy, semi-transparent layout containers so the glowing pink moon shows through perfectly across your entire dashboard and profile pages. Fully customizable opacity!
